needs_review: AUTH UNCHANGED from the scaffold: the X-Api-Key header is what https://docs.apollo.io/reference/authentication documents (its own curl sample uses the same header, case-insensitively as 'x-api-key'), and a live probe with a dummy key answers 401 {"error":"Invalid API key. See https://docs.apollo.io/reference/authentication ..."}, which is Apollo reading the header.

test.path CORRECTED TWICE from the scaffold's /v1/auth/health. First, every Apollo REST route is under /api/v1 (the docs' own base is https://api.apollo.io/api/v1), so the scaffolded path could never route; base_url stays the host and the /api/v1 prefix rides in each path, matching the committed stripe/hubspot style. Second, the shape-proof run of 2026-09-12 showed /api/v1/auth/health answering HTTP 200 {"healthy":true,"is_logged_in":false} to a DUMMY key, so it cannot verify a credential at all: it would activate any string as a valid Apollo key. test is therefore GET /api/v1/users/api_profile, which is credential-gated (401 with a bad key).

PATHS DIFFER FROM THE BRIEF, which asked for /organizations/search and /people/search. The current official reference documents POST /api/v1/mixed_companies/search (Organization Search) and POST /api/v1/mixed_people/api_search (People API Search); the legacy apolloio.github.io paths are not in today's docs, so the documented ones are used.

Both search endpoints are POST with QUERY-STRING parameters, not a JSON body: the docs list q_organization_name / q_person_name / q_keywords / page / per_page as query params (readme param ids 'query-organizationSearch_*' and 'query-peopleApiSearch_*'). No request body is sent, so nothing the caller supplies can reach a body field.

READ-ONLY by design: no tool is marked write:true and every request is a documented read (two GETs plus two search endpoints whose semantics are read-only). Apollo's own rate limit on mixed_companies/search is 600 calls/hour per the docs, well above this spec's 30/minute cap.
per_page is clamped to 100 and page to 500. The docs pages state no explicit maximum for either, so the clamps are this spec's own conservative ceiling, not a documented limit.
search_people uses /mixed_people/api_search, whose documented response returns last_name_obfuscated rather than last_name; the pick reflects that rather than inventing a full-surname field.

Shape-proof 2026-09-12 (apollo.proof.json, runner shapeproof/1), verbatim: 'apollo  SHAPE_PROVEN  proven=5 authwall=0 ambiguous=0 failed=0 inconclusive=0 skipped=0'. The control probe at a bogus path answers 404 while all five real requests answer a structured 401 'Invalid API key', so the differential proves host, TLS, base_url, the X-Api-Key header and every path; only a real key can prove the response bodies.
